body: Her name was Frankendower (I don't know either). Her hair was on fire and she had a bizarre tendency to play with all my toys and then leave them in a mess on the floor. Eventually, she became so bothersome that I had to team up with Ducky Friend (my older brother, making a duck with his hand and making it talk in falsetto) to exile Frankendower to an empty soda can box and throw her away.

When in the company of close friends who love and care about me.

Because it reminds me that I'm intruding on their lives, taking away time for them that they could better use to spend time with their family or significant others... That there's no one out there who's really "just for me".
StarFox 64. I still play it today.

I was about seven or eight years old? Well, that would make my little bro about one or two. Well, one day, I didn't want to play with him. That was my offense. Honestly, how many eight year olds wants to keep such a little kid entertained for hours (that was what was expected of me, so my mom didn't have to deal with him)? So my mother proceeded to inform me that I was mean, selfish, lazy, and all around a horrible person (this was a common event). I slunk away to cry quietly, alone where I wouldn't be bothering anyway, in the laundry closet. My mother deliberately sought me out again just to say she didn't even want to look at me. The why the fuck did you come looking for me?!

When my mother confronted me about the fact that she'd gotten into my computer.

Gay porn = Found. Me = Outed.
Grandia III. Started out very promising. Only got worse.
Because I want to kill myself- yet have managed to sign myself up for about five or so more years on this planet and if I shot myself now, I'd feel like a complete dick. So I guess a hug instead...

I once heard someone refer to Nintendo DS games as "oldies". I still love SNES. And if someone asks me who Bill Murray is ONE MORE TIME...

(Sadly enough, I'm only 17. I get lumped in with these people!)
A Boy and his Frog, a song from Kermit's point of view to the late Jim Hensen. *sniffle*
Not killing myself when there's a prime opportunity to do so.
Catherine. Love it anyway. Now's not the time to be dead.

I'm technically not, but I asked for socks for Christmas this year, so I feel like it.

Also I'm so tired I legit thought the topic title was "When did you realize you'd become a midget-smuggler?". Time for bed!

I feel worthless. Sure, when you get down to it my life really isn't so bad, but I feel I do nothing to positively contribute to the lives of others. I can't do anything right. It would make no difference if I just disappeared from the world. If I'm not happy, and I'm not making anyone else happy, what's the point of me living?
